techniques.name: Definitional analysis
techniques.purpose: Replaces ambiguous key terms with precise working definitions and produces a glossary with borderline cases.

techniques.name: Historical analogy and parallel analysis
techniques.purpose: Places the present topic beside a past case and rates each likeness and difference, producing a likenesses and differences table that shows where a lesson from the past case may and may not be applied.

techniques.name: Absence analysis
techniques.purpose: Draws a conclusion from an item missing from a document or comparison set where it would be expected if a claim were true, producing a list of expected but absent items.

techniques.name: Lens application
techniques.purpose: Sorts a set of claims or measures by chosen categories, such as input or outcome, and produces a table of claims by category.

techniques.name: Analysis of competing hypotheses
techniques.purpose: Lists plausible hypotheses, rates each evidence item against each, and produces a hypothesis by evidence matrix aimed at disproving hypotheses.

techniques.name: Toulmin argument analysis
techniques.purpose: Labels the parts of an argument as claim, ground, warrant, backing, rebuttal and qualifier and produces a diagram per argument.

techniques.name: Fallacy analysis
techniques.purpose: Compares an argument with a list of known defective patterns and produces a list of suspected defects, each read as a prompt for missing support.

techniques.name: Key assumptions check
techniques.purpose: Lists the stated and unstated premises of the current line, challenges each, and produces a refined assumptions register with the conditions that would invalidate each assumption.

techniques.name: Disconfirmation search
techniques.purpose: Looks for evidence that would contradict a favoured claim and produces a list of refuting evidence found or not found with the search used.

techniques.name: Internal consistency check
techniques.purpose: Tests whether the claims, figures and assumptions within one analysis are compatible with each other and produces a list of contradictions or inconsistent figures.
